slots.title: Route libérée
slots.themeBrief: Victoire calme, sans cible blessée ni pose de portrait reprise.

slots.poseEnglish: Relaxed upright seated victory on a brass cargo crate, one ankle crossed over the opposite knee, slight confident smile; RIGHT-hand rapier lowered beside the crate and LEFT-hand pistol resting safely across thigh with muzzle away from body.

slots.poseEnglish: Exhausted seated defeat on the floor against a cold boiler, both legs extended fully inside frame, slumped shoulders and bowed head; RIGHT hand loosely holds rapier near floor while pistol rests on the floor at her anatomicalLEFT, no wounds.

slots.title: Monopole de la capitaine
slots.themeBrief: What If : la libératrice impose le monopole de l’air, uniforme fermé et distribution visiblement verrouillée.
slots.themeSource: Elara individual V2 visual + originalUniversesManifest AetherCrown lore; imposed fifteen-slot CG matrix; CG12 adaptation authored in this plan

slots.poseEnglish: WHAT IF alignment reversal, unmistakably speculative: authoritarian Elara stands rigidly at attention with feet together, RIGHT-hand rapier vertical before her and LEFT-hand pistol lowered. Same V2 identity, a rigid burgundy/black/gold uniform variation, stern expression; chained air valves and identical sealed access gates visibly invert her freedom-of-routes role. No real-world insignia.

slots.poseEnglish: WHAT IF male counterpart of Elara, clearly masculine facial jaw/brow and shoulders without changing skin, dark-brown wavy high updo, V2 burgundy/gold costume or anatomical weapon sides. Keep V2 brown updo, burgundy/gold coat and the thin RIGHT-hand rapier / LEFT-hand brass pistol intact, no gore or body damage.

Sit sideways on a navigation bench with one boot on a low footrest, both hands unfolding a plain map; exact original rapier and pistol set aside nearby. No assertion of her current age.
